ACML manufactures and exports premium-quality compact and Elitwist cotton yarn for hosiery and weaving. It manufactures premium-quality compact yarn by optimally blending imported and indigenous cotton, primarily for finer shirting requirements. The company spins cotton yarn primarily in the finer count range of 60s-100s.
